title: Federal FJC IDB class-action duration benchmarks

scope.sourceSystem: Federal Judicial Center Integrated Database (FJC IDB)
scope.statement: These are federal docket-duration estimates. They do not represent all U.S. class actions, state-court cases, an open-claim inventory, or time from claim filing to payment.

source.format: ZIP containing a tab-delimited text file
source.updateCadence: Quarterly source snapshots; publication lag varies.
source.coverageLabel: Cases terminated in SY 1988 through March 31, 2026 and cases pending as of March 31, 2026

methodology.estimator: Kaplan-Meier product-limit estimator with right censoring
methodology.observationUnit: Unique federal docket identifier. Reinstated/reopened IDB rows sharing that identifier are collapsed into one lifecycle.
methodology.dateFields: FILEDATE and TERMDATE are used for elapsed time. FDATEUSE and TDATEUSE are AO reporting-cohort dates and are not duration endpoints.
methodology.mdlRule: ORIGIN 6 and 13 are reported separately and excluded from the recommended default cohort.
methodology.classActionQuality: CLASSACT records a plaintiff allegation that Rule 23 prerequisites are met; it is not proof of certification. FJC says this field has no quality-control checks and can change as records are updated.
methodology.settlementQuality: DISP=13 is a federal case disposition marked settled. It does not prove a court-approved class settlement, an open claim window, claimant eligibility, payment, or recovery amount.
methodology.pendingRule: STATUSCD=S or TAPEYEAR=2099 identifies a pending record. The cumulative tab export currently places 01/01/1900 in TERMDATE for those rows; that sentinel is ignored and the row is censored at the source snapshot date.
methodology.reopenRule: Repeated docket identifiers, commonly ORIGIN 4 or 8-12 reopen records, are collapsed. The lifecycle starts at the earliest CLASSACT=1 FILEDATE and ends at the latest TERMDATE, unless any record is currently pending.
methodology.censoring: Pending dockets are censored at source.snapshotDate. In the recorded-settlement clock, a docket with no DISP=13 is censored at its final endpoint and treated as a competing non-settlement closure.

cohorts.label: Federal cases alleging a Rule 23 class action — all origins
cohorts.interpretation: Right-censored federal docket-lifecycle estimate for dockets with at least one record marked CLASSACT=1.

allTermination.label: Federal docket lifecycle: earliest class-coded filing to final recorded termination
allTermination.start: Earliest FILEDATE among records for the docket with CLASSACT=1
allTermination.event: Latest valid TERMDATE when the docket has no current pending record
allTermination.censoring: Any current STATUSCD=S/TAPEYEAR=2099 record: right-censored on the FJC snapshot date
allTermination.quantileRule: First observed day where the Kaplan-Meier survival estimate is at or below the corresponding survival threshold.

recordedSettlement.label: Time from earliest class-coded filing to first recorded settlement disposition
recordedSettlement.start: Earliest FILEDATE among records for the docket with CLASSACT=1
recordedSettlement.censoring: Dockets without DISP=13 are censored on the snapshot date if pending, otherwise on their final TERMDATE.
recordedSettlement.competingRiskCaveat: This is a cause-specific Kaplan-Meier view, not a cumulative-incidence estimate; non-settlement closures are informative competing events.
recordedSettlement.quantileRule: First observed day where the Kaplan-Meier survival estimate is at or below the corresponding survival threshold.
